cases.expected: Remaining seats are clamped to zero

cases.expected: 10 capacity minus 4 registrations equals 6 seats

cases.expected: EVENT_FULL

cases.expected: EVENT_FULL

cases.expected: EVENT_STARTED

cases.title: Register for an event
cases.expected: An attendee signs in, registers for a published event with places, sees confirmation, and one place is removed.
cases.actual: Registration HTTP 201; confirmation shown; remaining seats changed from 3 to 2

cases.title: Publish an event
cases.expected: A draft is hidden from attendees before publishing and visible after an admin publishes it.
cases.actual: Draft detail/list hidden before publication; attendee HTTP 200 after status changed to PUBLISHED

cases.title: Register twice
cases.expected: The same attendee cannot create a second active registration for the same event, and only one registration remains.
cases.actual: Second registration HTTP 409 with ALREADY_REGISTERED; active registrations for event: 1

cases.title: Full event
cases.expected: After all places are taken, an extra attendee is blocked and the event reports no places left.
cases.actual: First registration HTTP 201; extra registration HTTP 409 with EVENT_FULL; event shows full

cases.title: Closed or past event
cases.expected: Registrations for cancelled, completed, and past-date events are all blocked.
cases.actual: Cancelled, completed, and past-date attempts all returned HTTP 409 with the expected closed/started reasons

cases.title: Cancel a registration
cases.expected: Cancelling one registration on a full event frees the place and lets a different attendee register.
cases.actual: Cancellation HTTP 200; replacement attendee registration HTTP 201; place was reused

cases.title: Wrong capacity
cases.expected: Zero, negative, decimal, and below-current-registration capacities are rejected with clear validation.
cases.actual: 0, -1, and 2.5 returned HTTP 422 field errors; capacity below two active registrations returned CAPACITY_TOO_LOW

cases.title: Attendee tries admin actions
cases.expected: An attendee cannot open admin pages or perform admin mutations, including a direct request.
cases.actual: Admin page redirected with HTTP 307; direct event mutation blocked with HTTP 403 by the server

cases.title: Someone else's registration
cases.expected: An attendee cannot open or receive another attendee's registration details.
cases.actual: Own registration HTTP 200; another attendee's registration HTTP 403; private details omitted

cases.title: Attendee list and totals
cases.expected: After three registrations and one cancellation, the event list shows two active attendees, search/export/copy controls are available, and dashboard totals survive refresh.
cases.actual: Event-scoped admin list shows 2 active attendees after one cancellation; search/copy/CSV controls present; dashboard active total 14 stayed unchanged after refresh
